item.title: Night ride, a 60 s single take

turns.text: Make a 60-second single continuous take, widescreen, live action: a bicycle courier in a yellow rain jacket rides through a rainy city at night. It starts with her crossing a bridge and ends as she stops at the lit door of a small café and steps off the bike. No cuts and no camera jumps: the same rider, the same jacket, the same bike, the same rain and the same night light from the first second to the last. Ambient sound only: rain, tyres, the city. No music, no speech, no text on screen.
